name: Narendra Properties Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, Narendra Properties 
Ltd is a building construction company.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) NPL is in the business of building construction and flat promotion. 
b) It undertakes development projects of residential and commercial multi-storied flat
 complexes. 
c) The operations of the company are presently confined to localities in and around Chennai and its suburbs. 
d) It owns immovable properties at Sholinganallur, Chennai. 
e) The company has developed over 2.5 million sq. ft. area

pros: Stock is trading at 0.71 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 42.1%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 6.89% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.50 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 868 days to 1,253 days
